title: Kis Ne Batao Zehar Diya Moula Hassan Ko
body:
Teeron Se Kis Ne Surkh Kiya Is Kay Kafan Ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Dozakh Banay Ga Joda Tera Ab To Thikanaa
Lanat Karay Ga Hashar Talak Tujh Peh Zamana
Tu Ne Zehar Jo De Diya Imam e Zaman Ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya Janti Nahin Ti Yeh Ahmad Ka Sukhan Hai
Mera Hai Lakht e Jigar Hassan Mera Badan Hai
Kyun Maara Pahla Teer Mohammad Kay Badan Ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasim Ki Maa Se Bolay Sheh e Hassan e Mujtaba
Mere Jigar Kay Tukray Kahin Farwa De Chupha
Qasim Bula Nah Laye Kaheen Meri Behan Ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasim Kay Sar Seh Baap Kah Saya Hai Uth Gaya
Farwa Ne Ro Ke Zainab O Kulsoom Se Kaha
Ummat Ne Kaar Diya Hai Weeraan Meray Sahair Ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Saar Main Hain Khaak Daalay Huway Log Jo Fida
Zainab Karay Gi Hashar Main Un Ke Liye Dua
De Ne Hain Aaye Pursa Jo Khatoun e Azan Ko.
